correctness.rationale: For each black edge uv outside white-edge graph F, its white neighbors in L(K_n) number d_F(u)+d_F(v). Thus a possible force removes a leaf edge and uses an isolated other endpoint; a cycle cannot lose its first edge; if no isolate and any white edge remains, no first force is legal. Conversely the initially isolated vertex provides a permanent forcing anchor for leaf deletion in a forest. Each white-forest with isolate uniquely determines a zero-forcing set. Labeled forest EGF from Cayley and exponential formula proves all coefficients; at n>=3 extrema follow from n-2 white edges and an isolate. Independently enumerated all subsets for n=3,4,5; exactly H3=(1,3), H4=(1,6,12), H5=(1,10,45,80), zero mismatches. This does not extrapolate finite tests to all n.
